headline: Contracts for Pawtucket High School construction packages to Shawmut Design & Construction, plus Mass Insight and Onward We Learn contracts.
summary: The meeting covers seven award recommendations for Pawtucket High School construction packages, all to Shawmut Design & Construction. It also includes construction updates, a graduation rate audit process, a homeschool approval draft, and a closed session on a lawsuit.
